## Clauses

- TS 24.501 5.4.1.3.7 b) (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)
- TS 24.501 Table 10.2.2 T3560 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-16: adds a WB-N1/CE mode value of 24s; the normal value stays 6s; Rel-17: adds 11s for access via a satellite NG-RAN cell; the normal value stays 6s)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-T3560-AUTH-RETRANSMIT.md).
